Android requires location enabled, with precise location permission to be granted, in order to read SSIDs used for Wi-Fi network overrides. For automatic switching in the background, you need to allow location access all the time in app permissions.\n\nGlobal defaults for Wi-Fi and mobile networks work without these permissions.
